system.name: AMCN (Adaptive Multi-prompt Contrastive Network)
system.one_liner: A CLIP-based network for few-shot OOD detection that learns ID and OOD prompts with class-wise adaptive boundaries and a prompt-guided ID-OOD separation module.

content.variant_note: three small motivation tiles (task contrast, AUROC versus shots, class diversity) above one large tinted framework tile with train and test regions
content.argues: Few-shot OOD detection suffers when the number of shots shrinks and classes differ in diversity; adaptive multi-prompt boundaries per class (AMCN) keep performance high.
content.subject: Four tiles: traditional versus few-shot OOD setting, AUROC versus shots for three methods, class diversity of tabby versus ox, and the AMCN train and test framework.

Diversity comparison between the “cat” class and the “ox” class.

summary: AMCN targets few-shot out-of-distribution detection with CLIP: it learns ID prompts, label-fixed and label-adaptive OOD prompts, class-wise thresholds from intra- and inter-class distributions, and a prompt-guided ID-OOD separation module. Figure 1 is a four-tile composite. (a) draws the same class-by-shot photo grid with ID and OOD test columns for traditional OOD detection and, after a Few-shot learning arrow, for few-shot detection with 1-shot and K-shot brackets. (b) plots AUROC against shots for NPOS, PALM and Ours, which stays near 96 while the others fall. (c) contrasts tabby cats (narrow bell curve) with oxen (wide curve). (d) shows the framework: colour-coded statistics branches feed four prototypes with Pull and Push, then cosine similarity at test time.
summary_zh: AMCN用CLIP做少样本OOD检测。图1含四块：(a)传统与少样本设定对比；(b)AUROC随样本数变化，Ours持平而NPOS、PALM下降；(c)虎斑猫与牛分布宽窄不同；(d)多色统计分支得四个原型，拉近ID、推远OOD。
notes: No paragraph of the paper mentioning the figure was found; (a)-(c) are clear from the caption, but in (d) the pairing of branches with prototypes, the route of the black line from the P_c formula to the Test region and the exact role of Intra-class and Inter-class DN were read from the drawing and the abstract only. Prior kinds are kept but re-ordered: the four lettered tiles make contribution-mosaic the primary kind, and the problem-then-fix reading (b, c as diagnosis, d as remedy) is carried by side-by-side-contrast. Counts of thumbnails and icons are read from the preview and are approximate; the digest places 78 bitmaps (36 different), among them the two chart rasters. The caption speaks of a 'cat' class in (c) while the figure labels it Tabby.
